description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Felix 2026-11-11: undecided. Considered two storage engines behind one interface (open git engine for open-source and local use; proprietary, paid hosted engine without commit logic for organizations), then found it still feels like a compromise, as did server-side commits per person and per-user worktrees (53a03e76). Under discussion, proposed by Claude and not accepted: give every idea a holder (you change what is yours and can only attach to the rest), so that authority lives in the model and storage becomes a detail.
